columns.name: connection_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES luno_connections (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES luno_connections (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portfolios" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4282090230, "cost_basis_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'average', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_type" TEXT NULL, "exchange" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "sector" TEXT NULL, "industry" TEXT NULL, "last_meta_refresh" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "luno_connections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "portfolio_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES portfolios (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key_id_hint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "home_fiat" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credentials_missing', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "write_perm_warning" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("write_perm_warning" IN (0, 1)), "unrecognised_rows" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "portfolio_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES portfolios (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "symbol" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "trade_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "fees" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "fx_rate_to_base" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', "notes" TEXT NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "connection_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES luno_connections (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "executed_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlist_items" ("watchlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES watchlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("watchlist_id", "symbol"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quote_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_history_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" TEXT NOT NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "open" REAL NOT NULL, "high" REAL NOT NULL, "low" REAL NOT NULL, "close" REAL NOT NULL, "adj_close" REAL NULL, "volume" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "interval", "ts"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_meta" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" TEXT NOT NULL, "oldest_ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "newest_ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "interval"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dividend_events_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "ex_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "pay_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "ex_date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_events_cache" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_mappings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mapping_json" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "luno_account_cursors" ("connection_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES luno_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "last_row_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "balance_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "reserved_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "unconfirmed_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("connection_id", "account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "luno_markets_cache" ("pair" TEXT NOT NULL, "base" TEXT NOT NULL, "counter" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "volume_scale" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "trading_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pair"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "luno_ledger_rows" ("connection_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES luno_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timestamp_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("connection_id", "account_id", "row_index"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transactions_connection_external ON transactions (connection_id, external_id)
